description_en: Queries the details about the DDoS attack events that occurred on an Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 查询单个DDoS原生防护实例上发生的DDoS攻击事件详情
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-ddos-event --start-time 1633017600 --end-time 1638288000 --page-size 10 --page-no 1 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDdosEvent

parameters.help_en: The start time of the DDoS attack events to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS攻击事件的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the DDoS attack events to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS攻击事件的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含DDoS攻击事件的数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The attacked IP address to query
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Events.description_en: The details about the DDoS attack event

EndTime.description_en: The time when the DDoS attack stopped. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 攻击结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Mbps.description_en: The volume of the request traffic at the start of the DDoS attack. Unit: Mbit/s
Mbps.description_zh: 攻击开始时刻的请求流量大小。单位：Mbps

Pps.description_en: The number of packets at the start of the DDoS attack. Unit: packets per second (PPS)
Pps.description_zh: 攻击开始时刻的报文数量大小。单位：pps

StartTime.description_en: The time when the DDoS attack started. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 攻击结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Status.description_en:
The status of the DDoS attack event. Valid values:

hole_begin: indicates that blackhole filtering is triggered for the attacked IP address.
hole_end: indicates that blackhole filtering is deactivated for the attacked IP address.
defense_begin: indicates that attack traffic is being scrubbed.
defense_end: indicates that attack traffic is scrubbed
Status.description_zh:
攻击事件的当前状态。取值：

hole_begin：表示被攻击IP正处于黑洞状态。
hole_end：表示被攻击IP已从黑洞状态中解除。
defense_begin：表示正在清洗攻击流量。
defense_end：表示已结束攻击流量清洗

Total.description_en: The total number of DDoS attack events that are returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的DDoS攻击事件的总数量
